item.description: Pensana (LSE:PRE) said construction of its $250 million Longonjo rare earth project in Angola has reached 22% completion, with development remaining on schedule and within budget ahead of first mixed rare earth carbonate production targeted for 2027. The company expects the mine to initially produce 20,000 tonnes of mixed rare earth carbonate annually, with output planned to increase to 40,000 tonnes per year from approximately 2029.
item.title: Pensana progresses Longonjo development and expands integrated rare earth supply chain (PRE)
